text:
irene: Quick company announce — Hosted API: Streaming SDK + tool-calling is GA as of today. This adds server-streaming endpoints, new client SDK helpers (auto-reconnect + backpressure), and first-class structured tool-calling with JSON schema validation. Docs + quickstart: https://intranet.redwood.dev/hosted/streaming-ga

sam: Awesome — congratulations all! A couple quick questions: will older clients automatically fall back to polling? any breaking changes to token usage?

irene: Good Q. Fallback: yes, server supports long-poll fallback for legacy clients. No token changes — same auth headers. We do add an opt-in header for tool-calling scope: `X-RW-Tool-Call: true` (see SDK upgrade notes).

dev-rel: I'll queue a migration blog and some example repos. Can someone paste a minimal curl snippet for the announcement?

ana: here's a tiny curl example for streaming:```bash
curl -N -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" 
  -H "Accept: text/event-stream" 
  https://api.redwood.com/v1/stream?model=rdl-13b \\n  -d '{"prompt":"Summarize this..."}'
```

ana: and for tool-calls (structured):```json
POST /v1/toolcall?model=rdl-rlhf-13b
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "input": "translate to french: hello",
  "tools": ["translator_v1"],
  "tool_schema": {"translator_v1": {"type":"object","properties":{"text":{"type":"string"}}}}
}```

ana: SDKs will generate helpers so most customers won't handcraft these.

deploy-bot: rollout/hosted-streaming-ga started by @irene — strategy: canary -> 10% -> 50% -> 100%. Current status: at 10% (region us-west-2) as of 1769456890.

luis: Support note: support playbook pinned in #support. Known error codes to call out in the doc: TOOL_SCHEMA_MISMATCH, STREAM_TIMEOUT, BACKPRESSURE_OVERFLOW. Suggested retries: exponential backoff up to 3 retries for transient stream drops.

cto: Great work. Two asks: 1) add per-model tail-latency and cost-by-token metrics to Console dashboards, 2) add an alert for 95th pct latency > 500ms in any production cluster. Ops please confirm.

ana: Ops forwarding to eng-sre. We're adding resource-level tracing hooks so you can correlate streams -> kernels.

irene: Migration notes: legacy `v1/generate` endpoints will continue for 90 days; we recommend customers upgrade to `/v1/stream` for streaming and `/v1/toolcall` for tool-calling. We'll publish an automated migration script in the repo by EOD.

sam: Will there be any changes to pricing?

irene: No list-price changes today. We are introducing model variants with different cost profiles (e.g., `rdl-lite-7b-quant` for lower-cost) and those will show per-token pricing in Console.

dev-rel: Planning a community webinar + quick demo tomorrow at 11am PT — I'll post invite.

cto: One more: please add a short internal security checklist for tool-calls (schema injection, allowed tool list per-tenant). Security and Compliance to review.

irene: On it. We'll run a short all-hands demo tomorrow at 11am PT and follow-up FAQ in #announcements. Huge thanks to eng-runtime, eng-ml, dev-rel, and infra for moving this over the finish line. :tada: :shipit:

deploy-bot: rollout/hosted-streaming-ga progressed to 50% at 1769456995.
